headline.text: Tech stocks fall on doubts over AI spending
headline.context: Nasdaq down 2.9%, S&P 500 down 1.8% on Friday.
headline.vo: US tech stocks fell sharply on Friday, as investors questioned whether huge spending on artificial intelligence will pay off soon. The Nasdaq dropped two point nine percent, and the S&P 500 had its worst day since June.

beats.label: Intel's share drop, its worst day since 1974
beats.vo: The chipmaker Intel lost almost twenty-nine percent, its worst day since 1974. It forecast weaker sales than analysts expected, partly because the PC market is shrinking. Amazon also worried investors with heavy spending on AI.

text: Chip stocks fell *7.2%* in one day.
beats.vo: A key index of chip stocks fell more than seven percent. Both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 ended October with a monthly loss.

beats.quote: It doesn't kill the whole story, it's pretty much a reset.
beats.vo: Some traders say prices had simply risen too fast. Joe Saluzzi of Themis Trading said the fall does not end the AI story, but is a reset.

title: Tech stocks fall as Intel has its worst day since 1974
caption: US tech stocks fell sharply on Friday as investors questioned whether huge AI spending will pay off soon. Intel lost almost 29% after a weak forecast, and the Nasdaq dropped 2.9%. Both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 ended October with a monthly loss.
